changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT est.id, frr.resource_id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles est JOIN role_resources frr ON frr.role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'FOREMAN') WHERE est.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources err WHERE err.role_id = est.id AND err.resource_id = frr.resource_id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT err.id, frro.operation_id FROM role_resources err JOIN roles est ON err.role_id = est.id AND est.code = 'ESTIMATOR' JOIN role_resources frr ON frr.resource_id = err.resource_id AND frr.role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE code = 'FOREMAN') JOIN role_resource_operations frro ON frro.role_resource_id = frr.id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations erro WHERE erro.role_resource_id = err.id AND erro.operation_id = frro.operation_id );

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM roles WHERE code = 'ESTIMATOR'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND res.code = 'OFFERS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r2 ON rr.role_id = r2.id JOIN resources res2 ON rr.resource_id = res2.id WHERE r2.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND res2.code = 'OFFERS' );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('READ', 'CREATE', 'UPDATE') WHERE r.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND res.code = 'OFFERS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations rro WHERE rro.role_resource_id = rr.id AND rro.operation_id = o.id );

INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND res.code = 'ESTIMATE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r2 ON rr.role_id = r2.id JOIN resources res2 ON rr.resource_id = res2.id WHERE r2.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND res2.code = 'ESTIMATE' );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('READ', 'CREATE', 'UPDATE') WHERE r.code = 'ESTIMATOR' AND res.code = 'ESTIMATE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations rro WHERE rro.role_resource_id = rr.id AND rro.operation_id = o.id );
